statements.impact_statement: Measured 2026-11-18 on the simstudioai/sim v0.9.62 source. GHSA-965c-763c-88jm needs the Magic Link plugin enabled: an OAuth state value is accepted as a Magic Link token. Sim never enables it. The app's betterAuth() plugins come from apps/sim/lib/auth/auth.ts:19-27 (admin, captcha, customSession, emailOTP, genericOAuth, oneTimeToken, organization; no magicLink), and the realtime server's verifier imports only oneTimeToken (packages/auth/src/verify.ts:5). The one 'magic-link' string in the tree is a reserved provider id in apps/sim/lib/auth/sso/provider-repository.ts:23, not a plugin. The fix is only in better-auth 1.7.7, whose 1.7 line removes genericOAuthClient and changes the OAuth schema (1.7.0 release notes), so a drop-in bump breaks the build. Revisit when upstream Sim moves to 1.7.7 or enables Magic Link.

Measured 2026-11-18 on the simstudioai/sim v0.9.62 source. The advisory needs rate-limit records stored in PostgreSQL through the Drizzle adapter. Neither Sim betterAuth() call sets rateLimit (apps/sim/lib/auth/auth.ts, packages/auth/src/verify.ts), so better-auth 1.6.27 keeps them in memory, or in secondary storage when one is configured (dist/context/create-context.mjs:174, storage: options.rateLimit?.storage || (options.secondaryStorage ? 'secondary-storage' : 'memory')); the Drizzle adapter never stores them. Revisit if Sim sets rateLimit.storage to 'database'.

Measured 2026-11-18 on the simstudioai/sim v0.9.62 source. The advisory needs the opt-in deviceAuthorization() plugin (device login approval). Sim never enables it: the app's betterAuth() plugins are admin, captcha, customSession, emailOTP, genericOAuth, oneTimeToken and organization (apps/sim/lib/auth/auth.ts:19-27), and the realtime verifier imports only oneTimeToken (packages/auth/src/verify.ts:5). The fix is only on the breaking 1.7 line. Revisit if Sim enables deviceAuthorization.

Measured 2026-11-18 on the simstudioai/sim v0.9.62 source. The Kysely adapter is only a dependency of better-auth here: the app's betterAuth() uses Sim's own adapter (database: createSimAuthAdapter, apps/sim/lib/auth/auth.ts:333) and the realtime verifier uses drizzleAdapter (packages/auth/src/verify.ts:4), and neither call sets rateLimit, so better-auth 1.6.27 keeps rate-limit records in memory or secondary storage (dist/context/create-context.mjs:174), never in PostgreSQL through any adapter. Revisit if Sim switches to the Kysely adapter or sets rateLimit.storage to 'database'.

Measured 2026-11-18 on the simstudioai/sim v0.9.62 source. The advisory needs the OAuth Proxy plugin. Sim never enables it: no oAuthProxy anywhere in apps/sim, apps/realtime or packages, and the app's betterAuth() plugins are admin, captcha, customSession, emailOTP, genericOAuth, oneTimeToken, organization (apps/sim/lib/auth/auth.ts:19-27) plus oauthProvider, sso and stripe. The fix is only in better-auth 1.7.7 on the breaking 1.7 line. Revisit if Sim enables oAuthProxy.

Measured 2026-11-18 on the simstudioai/sim v0.9.62 source. The advisory needs more than one validAudiences entry, or JWT access tokens whose aud claim resource servers trust. Sim's oauthProvider() (apps/sim/lib/auth/auth.ts:1526) sets no validAudiences, so the only audience is the server's base URL and no token can target another one, and it sets disableJwtPlugin: true, so access tokens are opaque and revocable rather than JWTs carrying aud. Sim also binds the issued resource itself (customTokenResponseFields: bindOAuthIssuedResource, and upstream's oauth-provider patch adds the resource parameter to the authorize request). Revisit if Sim adds validAudiences or turns the JWT plugin on.
